## 2026-11-01 S1968 — R6 proper: actual q_v q-pilot object built; paper strip is the first missing; reduced anchor times-mu layer is trivial

Package: `tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1968QVDeterminedQPilotActual.lean`, EXIT=0, olean
`.lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1968QVDeterminedQPilotActual.olean`,
SHA256 `054904288F47BD6B8FECBE59D03F94641024E15199AC3A6F840A11A8D684547C`.
Axioms: only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`.

Built (actual, kernel-checked):

* The actual q_v data of the S1527/S1895 input: `paperQV D b = qParameter b`
  (nonzero, contracting, log-negative), with actual completed-DVR order
  `paperQVOrder D b` (= S1487Cand.order = order_C3), so
  `|log q_b| = order_b * log 5` and `order_b = |log q_b| / log 5` (the q_v
  determines the order).
* The q-pilot **object** of IUT III, Def. 3.8(i), at the object level:
  `paperQPilotDivisor D : IUTIVArithmeticDivisor (PaperFmod D)`, the
  order-weighted zero-locus divisor in S1927's global realified Frobenioid
  `C^boxplus_mod`.  Its degree is `sum_b |log q_b| = order_C3 * log 5 > 0`
  (`paperQPilotDivisor_deg_eq_source`, `_deg_pos`), and the q-pilot log-volume
  `paperQPilotLogVolume D = -deg = sourceQPilotSignedLog = -localLogMagnitude
  S1487Cand = -order_C3 * log 5 < 0`.  `QVDeterminedQPilotObject` packages
  divisor/degree/log-volume with these equalities, inhabited for every input.

Obstructions:

* The reduced anchor is the S1487 shear strip: `reducedQPilotAnchor D =
  S1487Strip 1 0`, whose value monoid is `SourceHaarActualValueMonoid =
  Multiplicative {x : Real // x <= 0}`.  Its unit group is **trivial**
  (x <= 0 and -x <= 0 force x = 0).  Hence `(reducedQPilotTimesMu D).timesMu v`
  is a subsingleton for every v (proved), and every candidate `P` with
  `Nonempty (QPilotAnchorIdentification D P)` has subsingleton times-mu fibers
  at every v (`r6Proper_forces_trivial_timesMu`).  The reduced anchor's whole
  x-mu layer is vacuous under the current value/unit model.
* The tree's Hodge-theater strips are q_v-blind: changing only the initial
  theta data keeps `I.fPrimeStripAt n m` definitionally fixed
  (`withInitial`, `fPrimeStripAt_withInitial`).  Concrete witness:
  `S1487FaithfulInput` and `S1487TwoPlaceInput` have the same (1,0) strip and
  the same canonical times-mu lift, but q-pilot log-volumes `-L` vs `-2L`
  (`candidate_blind`, `qPilot_scalar_differs`).  So the candidate
  `canonical (I.fPrimeStripAt 1 0)` (= `qPilotFTimesMuPrimeStripAt10`) cannot
  be certified q_v-determined.

First missing (a **definition**, not a proposition): a paper-side
`paperQPilotFTimesMuStrip D : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip PaperV` arising from
`paperQPilotDivisor D` via the associated-pilot-object construction of IUT II,
Def. 4.9(viii), together with its identification with the divisor.  The tree
has no such functor from the global realified Frobenioid (or from an arithmetic
divisor) to a prime strip; the only constructor is
`SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip.canonical`.  R6 proper is **not** closed; no fake
strip, no arbitrary inhabitant, no Prop slot was used.

Consequence for S1967: `OUnits D v = ((lgpStrip D).Mon v)^` is a subsingleton,
so any nontrivial `OUnitsMu` / x-mu Kummer construction on this strip is
vacuous unless the value monoid of the strip is changed.
